_comment: Documents the keys this repo's scripts expect at runtime. Real values go in .env (gitignored) as KEY=value lines, not in this file -- see CLAUDE.md's 'Secrets never enter git' invariant. This file itself is checked into git as documentation only.
STRAVA_ACCESS_TOKEN: Short-lived OAuth access token, used by ingestion/strava/verify_activity_id_alignment.py (issue #16)
